  |> set(key: "_field", value: "reaped")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_orphan_reap_freed_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "freed bytes/s")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)

base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_orphan_reap_us" and (r._field == "p50" or r._field == "p90" or r._field == "p99"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "run " + r._field}))
    |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])

lo = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /(p50|p90)$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
hi = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /p99$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [lo, hi])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "files")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_sm_nodes_by_health" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "nodes ")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "health", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_monitor_node_transitions" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "transitions to ")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "to", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
